trades.name: AppLovin Corporation

trades.name: Apple Inc.
trades.analysis: AAPL is in a rising trend channel, with the 50-day MA above the 200-day MA (golden cross), indicating a bullish long-term trend. The price is currently near its 20-day SMA, and a pullback to the 50-day MA around $325 could offer an entry.
